d.ko:
Fast-paced, Fluid Movement-FPS-Platformer🩸SPLATTER surfaces with your foe’s BLOOD. Move onto Zones of BLOOD to SOAK it up and keep fighting. Touch that BLOOD to ALTER {YOU} and your Weapons. 
[THE MEGASTRUCTURE] created you to stop them. Beckon our Extinction.
